name: Quillgrid Crosswords
subtitle: Fresh grids, lit walnut desk
shortDescription: Puzzles made on your device: dailies, six sizes, eighteen themed packs, fit-ins, ten lessons and a four-step hint ladder.
longDescription:
The crossword is barely a century old, born in a New York newspaper in 1913, and it has since become the quiet daily habit of millions. Quillgrid sets a fresh puzzle every time you ask and lays it out on a lit walnut desk where each letter is an ivory tile with some weight to it.

Today has a daily puzzle that is the same for everyone and grows bigger as the week goes on, with a streak and a calendar of the last two weeks. Quick play offers six sizes from a five-by-five Mini to a fifteen-by-fifteen Grand and four levels from Gentle to Fiendish. Eighteen themed packs of twelve puzzles cover creatures, birds, the sea, gardens, the pantry, travel, the night sky, science, music, art and more, and eight editions of ten puzzles open as you earn stars. Fit-ins have no clues: place every word from the list into the grid.

Ten short lessons you play on a tiny grid teach crossings, definitions, fill-in-the-blank, plurals and tenses and question-mark wordplay. Auto Play solves a real puzzle in front of you with the hint ladder and says why each answer fits. The four-step hint ladder goes from look to reason to a letter to the word, and there are pencil, check, reveal and undo.

Puzzles are generated by a forge on your device, so there is no end to them, and the same seed always gives the same puzzle. Lacquered blocks, a framed paper bed and a brass cursor that glides complete the desk.

Free with ads. Go ad-free with a monthly pass or earn ad-free time from videos.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
